promote.step3Description: Earn {{rate}} when a confirmed, qualifying new visitor arrives.
promote.coverageDescription: Approximate cells show where active posters are helping students discover events without exposing any promoter.

enrollment.schoolRequiredDescription: A school on your profile is required so your posters lead to the right campus event feed.

create.customDescription: Join our Discord and share it with us. We review submissions and add approved designs to the official collection.

create.oneLocationDescription: Each copy gets a unique QR so Wat2Do can measure and map that poster accurately.
create.error: The poster batch could not be created.

inventory.title: Poster inventory
inventory.description: Placed posters become quiet after {{days}} days without an accepted scan. Quiet posters are still active until archived.
inventory.emptyTitle: Create your first official Wat2Do poster
inventory.emptyDescription: Download it, place it on campus, and scan it yourself to activate the placement. The activation visitor earns $0.
inventory.activationInstruction: Place this copy, scan its QR, and allow location access to establish the placement.
inventory.downloadError: This poster could not be generated for download.
inventory.templateUnavailable: This legacy poster does not have a regeneratable template.
inventory.archiveDescription: {{name}} will keep redirecting, but it will stop recording payable visits and free one active slot.

payouts.title: Payout history
payouts.description: Monthly Interac e-Transfer records. Held payouts are reviewed rather than removed.
payouts.loadErrorDescription: Try again later. Your payout records have not been changed.

eligibility.title: Eligibility and enrollment
eligibility.body: You must use your own Wat2Do account, keep a school on your profile, provide an email that can receive Interac e-Transfers, and accept the current terms. Enrollment does not guarantee future poster availability.

posters.title: Official posters and placements
posters.body: Use only the approved files generated by Wat2Do. Each unique QR belongs to one physical placement. Do not duplicate a QR across locations. Archive a poster before moving or retiring its physical placement.

visitors.title: Qualifying visitors
visitors.body: The activation visitor is not payable. Earnings exclude duplicate, unconfirmed, automated, manipulated, and fraudulent traffic. Wat2Do may review unusual traffic before releasing a payout.

payments.title: Payments
payments.body: Eligible amounts are calculated for UTC calendar months at the program rate active for that period and are paid manually by Interac e-Transfer. Held amounts remain under review. Taxes and accurate payout details remain your responsibility.

conduct.title: Safe and respectful placement
conduct.body: Place posters only where you have permission. Do not cover required notices, damage property, misrepresent Wat2Do, or place materials where campus or local rules prohibit them.

privacy.title: Privacy and measurement
privacy.body: Wat2Do uses privacy-preserving visitor identifiers and approximate public coverage cells. Raw IP addresses are not stored. Your payout details and exact placements are not made public.

changes.title: Program changes and suspension
changes.body: Wat2Do may pause new enrollment or poster creation, retire designs, update these terms, or suspend participation for abuse. Existing QR redirects and earned payout records remain available according to the program rules.
